jobs.note: CPU no-op: models/T7--seed<s>/report.json {zero_shot: true, steps 0, gpu_seconds 0} (Decision P-adapter).

480 fit-anchor decision frames x 16 grid launches under the selected configuration (one worker pass, FLOPs on the first decision): G-rank, fit nonfinite share, MACs / candidate, wall / decision; readouts.json per arm-seed (one deterministic pass), written last; resumable per item. ~30 min + load.
CPU: readouts-manifest.json (readouts + weight pins) before any evaluation anchor is read.

The one scoring pass: eb.read_evaluation_anchors, then every mixed cell of the four inventories (512 decisions) and the 480 wrong-anchor fit frames x 16 grid launches in one worker pass (~63 min at 3.78 s); records/T7--seed<s>.json (one deterministic pass written as three seeds); refuses unless G-fid passed; resumable per item.

P-novelty (descriptive): novelty anchors + U / C* / P reference records, then the 464 mixed novelty levels from each level's decision frame (~29 min at 3.78 s) if T7's guards pass; resumable per item.

Hash-checks the records, re-scores the primary pass on the same GPU (exact row equality, every inventory and the wrong anchors; ~63 min), writes validation.json, re-derives the publication twice (byte-identical). Resumable: a paused re-score resumes per item; the receipt is rewritten on completion.
